question:
Identify whether the given statements about ionisation energy are correct or incorrect.
Statement A:
The ionisation energy of an atom is the amount of energy that is required to remove an electron from a mole of atoms in the gas phase.
Statement B:
The ionisation energy increases from top to bottom in groups and decreases from left to right across a period.

[SSC CPO 2023]
options: Only Statement B is correct
Only Statement A is correct
Both Statements A and B are correct
Both Statements A and B are incorrect
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Only Statement A is correct

Explanation:
Statement A is correct because ionization energy is the energy required to remove an electron from a mole of atoms in the gas phase. It is a fundamental property that indicates the energy needed to free an electron from atomic bonding. Statement B is incorrect because ionization energy decreases from top to bottom in groups (as electrons are farther from the nucleus and experience less attraction) and increases from left to right across a period (due to increasing nuclear charge and closer proximity of electrons to the nucleus).

Extra Facts:
Ionization energy is typically measured in kJ/mol or eV. In the periodic table, helium (He) has the highest ionization energy due to its stable electronic configuration, while cesium (Cs) has the lowest. Studying ionization energy is crucial for understanding chemical bonding, reactivity, and physical properties of elements.

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है केवल कथन A सही है

question:
A diagonal relationship is found between which pair of the following elements ?

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options: Li and Mg
Be and B
Be and Mg
Na and Mg
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Li and Mg

Explanation:
A Diagonal Relationship in the periodic table is a special relationship between two elements where one element is diagonally placed to the other. This relationship is mainly observed between elements of Group 1 and Group 2 with elements of Group 2 and Group 13. These elements exhibit similar physical and chemical properties. For example, Li (Lithium) and Mg (Magnesium) show a diagonal relationship. Both elements form oxides and hydroxides that are less soluble, and their carbonates decompose upon heating.

Extra Facts:
The diagonal relationship arises due to similarities in atomic size, ionization energy, and polarizing power of the elements. Another example is the diagonal relationship between Be (Beryllium) and Al (Aluminum). Both elements form amphoteric oxides that react with both acids and bases. The diagonal relationship helps in understanding the periodicity of properties in the periodic table.

question_hi:
निम्नलिखित तत्वों के किस युग्म के बीच विकर्ण संबंध पाया जाता है?

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options_hi: Li और Mg
Be और B
Be और Mg
Na और Mg
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है Li और Mg

Explanation:
विकर्ण संबंध (Diagonal Relationship) आवर्त सारणी में दो तत्वों के बीच पाया जाने वाला एक विशेष संबंध है, जहाँ एक तत्व दूसरे तत्व के विकर्ण (Diagonal) में स्थित होता है। यह संबंध मुख्य रूप से दूसरे समूह (Group 2) के तत्वों और तीसरे समूह (Group 13) के तत्वों के साथ पहले समूह (Group 1) और दूसरे समूह (Group 2) के तत्वों के बीच देखा जाता है। इन तत्वों के भौतिक और रासायनिक गुण समान होते हैं। उदाहरण के लिए, Li (लिथियम) और Mg (मैग्नीशियम) के बीच विकर्ण संबंध पाया जाता है। दोनों ही तत्वों के ऑक्साइड और हाइड्रॉक्साइड कम घुलनशील होते हैं, और दोनों ही कार्बोनेट्स गर्म करने पर विघटित हो जाते हैं।

Extra Facts:
विकर्ण संबंध का कारण तत्वों के आकार (Atomic Size), आयनन ऊर्जा (Ionization Energy), और ध्रुवण शक्ति (Polarizing Power) में समानता होना है। Be (बेरिलियम) और Al (एल्युमिनियम) के बीच भी विकर्ण संबंध पाया जाता है। दोनों ही तत्व एम्फोटेरिक (Amphoteric) ऑक्साइड बनाते हैं, जो अम्ल और क्षार दोनों के साथ प्रतिक्रिया करते हैं। विकर्ण संबंध आवर्त सारणी में तत्वों के गुणों की आवधिकता (Periodicity) को समझने में मदद करता है।

question:
The atomic number of lead is:

[SSC CGL 2022]
options: 81
78
82
79
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 82

Explanation:
The atomic number of lead is 82. The atomic number represents the number of protons in the nucleus of an atom. Lead is a heavy metal with the chemical symbol Pb (Plumbum) and belongs to Group 14 of the periodic table. Its electronic configuration is [Xe] 4f14 5d10 6s2 6p2. Lead is used in batteries, radiation shielding, and construction materials due to its high density and corrosion-resistant properties.

Extra Facts:
☛ The atomic weight of lead is 207.2 u.
☛ It is a soft, malleable, and ductile metal.
☛ Lead compounds like lead oxide (PbO) and lead carbonate (PbCO3) are used in paints, glass, and ceramics.
☛ Lead poisoning is harmful to human health, causing damage to the nervous system and kidneys.
☛ In ancient times, lead pipes were used for water supply, but they are now banned due to toxicity.

question:
Which element's atomic number in the periodic table is named seaborgium, according to the notation of IUPAC nomenclature ?

[SSC CGL 2023]
options: 110
106
102
113
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 106

Explanation:
According to the IUPAC (International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry) nomenclature, Seaborgium (Sg) is a synthetic radioactive element with the atomic number 106. It belongs to the transuranium series and was first synthesized in 1974 at the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory in the USA. The element is named after the renowned American chemist Glenn T. Seaborg, who made significant contributions to the discovery of heavy elements. Seaborgium is highly unstable, with all its isotopes being radioactive, and it has no naturally occurring isotopes.

Extra Facts:
Transuranium elements are those with atomic numbers greater than uranium (92). All these elements are radioactive and do not occur naturally; they are synthesized in laboratories. The most stable isotope of Seaborgium, Sg-271, has a half-life of about 2.4 minutes. It is located in Group 6 and Period 7 of the periodic table. The discovery and naming of Seaborgium have opened new avenues in the study of heavy elements.

question:
The number of valence electrons in a graphite atom is:

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Three
Four
Two
Five
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Four

Explanation:
Graphite is an allotrope of carbon. Each carbon atom in graphite has four valence electrons located in its outermost shell (valence shell). In graphite, each carbon atom forms covalent bonds with three other carbon atoms, while the fourth electron remains delocalized, enabling graphite to conduct electricity. This is why graphite is a good conductor of electricity. Carbon has an atomic number of 6 and an electronic configuration of 2,4, clearly indicating that it has four electrons in its outermost shell.

Extra Facts:
1. Graphite and diamond are both allotropes of carbon, but they have different properties. In diamond, each carbon atom forms covalent bonds with four other carbon atoms, making it hard and an insulator.
2. Graphite is used in pencils, lubricants, and electrodes.
3. Other allotropes of carbon include fullerenes and graphene, which have unique properties and are significant in science and technology.

ग्रेफाइट कार्बन का एक अपरूप है। कार्बन के प्रत्येक परमाणु में चार संयोजी इलेक्ट्रॉन होते हैं, जो इसके बाहरी कक्ष (संयोजी कक्ष) में स्थित होते हैं। ग्रेफाइट में, प्रत्येक कार्बन परमाणु तीन अन्य कार्बन परमाणुओं के साथ सहसंयोजक बंध बनाता है, जबकि चौथा इलेक्ट्रॉन मुक्त होकर विद्युत का चालन करने में सहायता करता है। यही कारण है कि ग्रेफाइट विद्युत का सुचालक होता है। कार्बन का परमाणु क्रमांक 6 है और इसका इलेक्ट्रॉनिक विन्यास 2,4 है, जिससे स्पष्ट होता है कि इसके बाहरी कक्ष में 4 इलेक्ट्रॉन होते हैं।

question:
Which among the following elements has the least atomic radius?

[SSC GD 2022]
options: B
O
Be
Li
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is O (Oxygen)

Explanation:
Atomic radius refers to the distance from the nucleus to the outermost electron shell of an atom. In the periodic table, atomic radius decreases from left to right across a period due to an increase in nuclear charge (number of protons), which pulls electrons closer to the nucleus. Among the given options—B (Boron), O (Oxygen), Be (Beryllium), and Li (Lithium)—O (Oxygen) has the highest atomic number (Z = 8) and is positioned farthest to the right in the periodic table, giving it the smallest atomic radius.

Extra Facts:
1. Atomic radius is measured in picometers (pm) or angstroms (Å).
2. Down a group in the periodic table, atomic radius increases due to the addition of electron shells.
3. Hydrogen (H) has the smallest atomic radius (53 pm), but it is not among the given options.
4. Highly electronegative elements like fluorine (F) and oxygen (O) have very small atomic radii.

question:
Which are the four quantum numbers for an electron present in 4f orbital?

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options: n=4, l =3, m = +1, s = +½
n=3,l =2, m = -2, s = +½
n=4,l =4, m = -4, s = -½
n = 4,l =3, m = +4, s = +½
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is n=4, l=3, m=+1, s=+½

Explanation:
Quantum numbers describe the state of an electron. For a 4f orbital:
1. Principal Quantum Number (n): Represents the energy level. For 4f, n=4.
2. Azimuthal Quantum Number (l): Represents the subshell. For f-orbital, l=3.
3. Magnetic Quantum Number (m): Represents the orbital orientation. For f-orbital, m can range from -3 to +3. Here, m=+1 is given, which is valid.
4. Spin Quantum Number (s): Represents the electron spin. It can be +½ or -½. Here, s=+½ is given.

Extra Facts:
1. For f-orbital, l=3 and it is divided into 7 orbitals (m=-3,-2,-1,0,+1,+2,+3).
2. Pauli's Exclusion Principle states that no two electrons in an atom can have the same set of all four quantum numbers.
3. The 4f orbital is found in lanthanide series elements, which are part of the f-block in the periodic table.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams

☛ What is the maximum number of electrons in any orbital? → 2

question:
Which of the following statement is 'true' for 'dobereiner's triads"?
I. Triads were in order of atomic masses.
II. Atomic mass of middle element was roughly the average of atomic masses of other two elements.

[SSC GD 2024]
options: Only I
Both I and II
Neither I nor II
Only II
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Both I and II

Explanation:
According to Dobereiner's Triads, elements were grouped into sets of three, called triads. In these triads, the atomic masses of the elements were in increasing order (Statement I is correct). Also, the atomic mass of the middle element was roughly the average of the atomic masses of the other two elements (Statement II is also correct). For example, in the triad of Lithium (Li), Sodium (Na), and Potassium (K), the atomic mass of Sodium (23) is the average of the atomic masses of Lithium (7) and Potassium (39), i.e., (7+39)/2 = 23. Thus, both statements are correct.

Extra Facts:
Dobereiner's Triads were proposed in 1817 by the German chemist Johann Wolfgang Dobereiner. It was an early attempt to classify elements. However, this method had several limitations, such as not all known elements could be arranged into triads. Later, Mendeleev's Periodic Table provided a more systematic classification of elements. Dobereiner's Triads played a significant role in the development of the periodic table.

निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन 'डॉबेराइनर के त्रिकों' के लिए 'सत्य' है?

न तो। और न ही ॥

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है । और ॥ दोनों

Explanation:
डॉबेराइनर के त्रिकों के अनुसार, तत्वों को तीन-तीन के समूहों में व्यवस्थित किया गया था, जिन्हें त्रिक कहा जाता है। इन त्रिकों में तत्वों के परमाणु द्रव्यमान आरोही क्रम में होते थे (कथन I सही है)। साथ ही, मध्य तत्व का परमाणु द्रव्यमान अन्य दो तत्वों के परमाणु द्रव्यमानों का लगभग औसत होता था (कथन II भी सही है)। उदाहरण के लिए, लिथियम (Li), सोडियम (Na), और पोटैशियम (K) के त्रिक में सोडियम का परमाणु द्रव्यमान (23) लिथियम (7) और पोटैशियम (39) के परमाणु द्रव्यमानों का औसत (7+39)/2 = 23 होता है। इस प्रकार, दोनों कथन सही हैं।

question:
In Newlands’ Octaves, the properties of lithium and ________ were found to be the same.

[SSC CGL 2024]
options: sodium
aluminium
magnesium
beryllium
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is sodium

Explanation:
According to Newlands’ Law of Octaves, when elements are arranged in order of increasing atomic weights, the properties of every eighth element are similar to those of the first. Lithium (Li) has an atomic number of 3, and the eighth element after it is sodium (Na), with an atomic number of 11. Both elements belong to the alkali metal group and share similar chemical properties, such as reacting with water to form alkaline solutions and having a valency of one.

Extra Facts:
Newlands’ Law of Octaves was a significant step in the development of the periodic table but had limitations. It worked well only for lighter elements and failed for heavier ones. Later, Mendeleev developed the periodic table based on atomic numbers, which was more accurate and comprehensive. This laid the foundation for the modern periodic table, which organizes elements based on their atomic numbers and electronic configurations.

question:

53

67
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 63

Explanation:
Dmitri Ivanovich Mendeleev developed the Periodic Table in 1869. At that time, scientists knew about only 63 elements. Mendeleev arranged these elements based on their atomic masses and chemical properties. He left gaps in his periodic table, which allowed space for elements to be discovered in the future. It was his foresight that the properties of later discovered elements matched his predictions.

Extra Facts:
Mendeleev's Periodic Table laid the foundation for the modern periodic table. He created a table with 8 groups and 12 periods. Today, we know that there are 118 elements in nature, out of which 94 occur naturally and the remaining 24 are synthetically produced. Mendeleev is also called the 'Father of the Periodic Table'.

question:
_________is the heaviest naturally occuring element of the Periodic Table with an atomic weight of 238.

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: Xenon
Uranium
Helium
Mercury
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Uranium

Explanation:
Uranium is the heaviest naturally occurring element in the Periodic Table with an atomic weight of 238. It is a radioactive element with atomic number 92. Uranium is used in nuclear power generation and nuclear weapons. It is found in the Earth's crust and has two major isotopes: U-238 and U-235. U-238 is more stable with a half-life of 4.5 billion years, while U-235 is more important for nuclear fission.

Extra Facts:
Uranium was discovered in 1789 by German chemist Martin Klaproth. It is a silvery-white metal that forms a black oxide when exposed to air. Uranium is used not only in energy production but also in medicine and research. It occurs naturally in minerals like pitchblende and uraninite. The element was named after the planet Uranus.

Which chemical element with atomic number 35 has a dark reddish-brown liquid with a burning pungent odour ?

[SSC MTS 2023]

Astatine
Bromine
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bromine

Explanation:
Bromine is a chemical element with atomic number 35 and symbol Br. It is the only non-metal that exists in a liquid state at room temperature. Bromine has a dark reddish-brown color and a burning, pungent odor. It is a member of the halogen group and is used in various chemical compounds such as flame retardants, pesticides, and pharmaceuticals. Extra Facts:
Bromine was discovered in 1826 by Antoine Jérôme Balard. It occurs naturally in seawater and underground brine. question:
Which of the following is a property of Metalloids?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Malleable
Ductile
Sonorous
Semiconductor
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Semiconductor

Explanation:
Metalloids are elements that exhibit properties intermediate between metals and non-metals. One of their key properties is being semiconductors, meaning they can conduct electricity but less efficiently than metals and more efficiently than non-metals. For example, Silicon (Si) and Germanium (Ge) are semiconductors widely used in electronic devices. Other options like malleable, ductile, and sonorous are properties of metals, which are not fully exhibited by metalloids.

Extra Facts:
Metalloids are located between metals and non-metals in the periodic table. Examples include Silicon, Boron, Arsenic, Antimony, and Tellurium. They are used in electronics, glass manufacturing, and semiconductor devices. Silicon is the most famous semiconductor, extensively used in computer chips and solar cells. Other properties of metalloids include having a metallic luster, being brittle, and participating in various chemical reactions.

Scandium's properties make it valuable in aerospace and sports equipment manufacturing.

question:
In the periodic table, as one goes down the group.which property doesn’t change?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Number of shells
Metallic character
Valency
Atomic size
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Valency

Explanation:
In the periodic table, as one moves down a group, valency does not change. Valency refers to the combining capacity of an element and remains the same for all elements in a group because they have the same number of electrons in their outermost shell (valence shell). For example, all alkali metals (Group 1) have a valency of 1 because they have one electron in their outermost shell.

On the other hand, the number of shells increases, metallic character increases, and atomic size also increases as new shells are added.

Extra Facts:
1. Valency determines the chemical nature of an element and remains constant within a group.
2. In the periodic table, valency changes across a period (left to right) but remains the same down a group (top to bottom).
3. Valency depends on the number of valence electrons, while atomic size depends on the nuclear charge and electron shielding effect.

आवर्त सारणी में, जब कोई समूह में नीचे जाता है, तो संयोजकता नहीं बदलती है। संयोजकता किसी तत्व की रासायनिक अभिक्रियाओं में भाग लेने की क्षमता होती है और यह समूह में सभी तत्वों के लिए समान होती है क्योंकि सभी तत्वों के बाहरी कोश (वैलेंस शेल) में इलेक्ट्रॉनों की संख्या समान होती है। उदाहरण के लिए, क्षार धातु समूह (Group 1) के सभी तत्वों की संयोजकता 1 होती है क्योंकि उनके बाहरी कोश में 1 इलेक्ट्रॉन होता है।

दूसरी ओर, कोश की संख्या बढ़ती है, धात्विक विशेषता बढ़ती है, और परमाणु आकार भी बढ़ता है क्योंकि नए कोश जुड़ते जाते हैं।

Extra Facts:
1. संयोजकता तत्व की रासायनिक प्रकृति को निर्धारित करती है और यह समूह में समान रहती है।
2. आवर्त सारणी में आवर्त (Period) में बाएं से दाएं जाने पर संयोजकता बदलती है, लेकिन समूह (Group) में नीचे जाने पर नहीं।
3. संयोजकता इलेक्ट्रॉनों की संख्या पर निर्भर करती है, जबकि परमाणु आकार नाभिक और इलेक्ट्रॉन कोशों के बीच आकर्षण बल पर निर्भर करता है।

question:

solution:

Explanation:

question:
In which musical note did Newland put the metals Co and Ni with halogens ?

[SSC CGL 2024]
options: Fa
Do
Re
Mi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Do

Explanation:
John Newlands proposed the 'Law of Octaves' in 1864. According to this law, when elements are arranged in order of increasing atomic weights, every eighth element has properties similar to the first. Newlands compared this to the octave in music. He placed cobalt (Co) and nickel (Ni) with halogens (F, Cl, Br, I) in the 'Do' note because these elements showed similar properties. This arrangement laid the foundation for the development of the modern periodic table.

Extra Facts:
Newlands' Law of Octaves was accurate only up to calcium (Ca) because noble gases had not been discovered at that time. In the modern periodic table, Co and Ni are not grouped with halogens but belong to the transition metals group. Newlands' work was a precursor to Mendeleev's Periodic Law, which arranged elements based on their atomic numbers.

question:
Which among the following is not an alkali metal and does not belong to the Group 1 of Periodic Table?

Explanation:
Group 1 of the Periodic Table consists of Alkali Metals, which include Lithium (Li), Sodium (Na), Potassium (K), Rubidium (Rb), Cesium (Cs), and Francium (Fr). पोटैशियम (K) एक रासायनिक तत्व है जिसका परमाणु क्रमांक 19 है। इसकी द्रव्यमान संख्या 39 है, जो नाभिक में प्रोटॉन और न्यूट्रॉन की संख्या का योग है। पोटैशियम के सबसे स्थिर आइसोटोप (K-39) में 19 प्रोटॉन और 20 न्यूट्रॉन होते हैं। द्रव्यमान संख्या किसी तत्व के विभिन्न आइसोटोप्स को पहचानने में मदद करती है। पोटैशियम के अन्य आइसोटोप्स (K-40, K-41) भी होते हैं, लेकिन K-39 सबसे अधिक प्रचुर मात्रा में पाया जाता है (लगभग 93.26%)।

Extra Facts:
पोटैशियम एक क्षार धातु है जो समूह 1 (आवर्त सारणी) में स्थित है। यह मानव शरीर के लिए एक आवश्यक खनिज है जो तंत्रिका आवेगों के संचरण और मांसपेशियों के संकुचन में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है। पोटैशियम की कमी से हाइपोकैलेमिया हो सकता है, जिससे मांसपेशियों में कमजोरी और हृदय संबंधी समस्याएं हो सकती हैं। पोटैशियम यौगिकों का उपयोग उर्वरकों, कांच निर्माण और दवाओं में किया जाता है।

question:
In the early 1800s, who discovered that each chemical element is made up of a unique type of atom and that atoms differ by their mass?

[SSC CGL 2023]
options: Antoine Lavoisier
John Dalton
Amedeo Avogadro
Robert Boyle
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is John Dalton

Explanation:
In the early 1800s, John Dalton proposed the Atomic Theory, stating that each chemical element is composed of a unique type of atom and that these atoms differ by their mass. Dalton's theory laid the foundation of modern chemistry by explaining that chemical reactions result from the rearrangement of atoms, not their creation or destruction. This theory became a cornerstone in the development of chemistry, providing a clear understanding of matter at the atomic level.

Extra Facts:
John Dalton's Atomic Theory remains a fundamental principle in chemistry. He also contributed to the understanding of the Law of Conservation of Mass and the Law of Definite Proportions. Dalton created a table of atomic weights, which was a precursor to the modern periodic table. His work paved the way for understanding the nature of substances at the molecular level, influencing future scientific discoveries.

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है जॉन डाल्टन

Explanation:
जॉन डाल्टन ने 19वीं शताब्दी के पूर्वार्ध में परमाणु सिद्धांत प्रस्तुत किया, जिसमें उन्होंने बताया कि प्रत्येक रासायनिक तत्व एक अद्वितीय प्रकार के परमाणु से बना होता है और ये परमाणु उनके द्रव्यमान के अनुसार भिन्न होते हैं। डाल्टन का सिद्धांत रसायन विज्ञान की नींव रखने वाला था, जिसमें उन्होंने यह भी स्पष्ट किया कि रासायनिक अभिक्रियाएँ परमाणुओं के पुनर्व्यवस्थित होने का परिणाम होती हैं, न कि उनके निर्माण या विनाश का। यह सिद्धांत आधुनिक रसायन विज्ञान के विकास में एक मील का पत्थर साबित हुआ।

Extra Facts:
जॉन डाल्टन का परमाणु सिद्धांत आज भी रसायन विज्ञान का एक महत्वपूर्ण आधार है। उन्होंने द्रव्यमान संरक्षण का नियम और निश्चित अनुपात का नियम को भी समझाने में मदद की। डाल्टन ने परमाणु द्रव्यमान की एक सारणी भी तैयार की, जो आज के आधुनिक आवर्त सारणी का पूर्ववर्ती थी। उनके कार्यों ने आणविक स्तर पर पदार्थों की प्रकृति को समझने का मार्ग प्रशस्त किया।
